doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 打造具有国际竞争力的制造业，是我国提升综合国力、保障国家安全、建设世界强国的必由之路
quote_en: Building an internationally competitive manufacturing sector is the only path to national strength and security.
notes: Headline of Made in China 2025; broad concept, no single SW industry. Targets: manufacturing power by 2025/2035/2049; key indicators table for 2020 and 2025.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 把智能制造作为两化深度融合的主攻方向
quote_en: Make intelligent manufacturing the main direction of deep IT-industry integration.
notes: Named project (智能制造工程) with 2020/2025 targets (-30%/-50% cost, cycle time, defect rate). Broad; component equipment coded in separate rows.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
concept_en: industrial base: core parts, processes, materials, technology base
quote_zh: 组织实施工业强基工程
quote_en: Organise and implement the industrial-base strengthening project.
notes: Named project; targets: 40% of core basic parts/materials self-supplied by 2020, 70% by 2025. Cross-sector.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 着力提升集成电路设计水平
quote_en: Make a determined effort to raise IC design capability.
notes: Also packaging and testing autonomy, supply of key manufacturing equipment.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 全面突破第五代移动通信（5G）技术
quote_en: Achieve comprehensive breakthroughs in fifth-generation mobile (5G) technology.
notes: Also high-end servers, mass storage, routers/switches, new base stations (servers would map to 计算机设备).

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 推进自主工业软件体系化发展和产业化应用
quote_en: Promote systematic development and industrial use of home-grown industrial software.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 加快高档数控机床、增材制造等前沿技术和装备的研发
quote_en: Speed up R&D of high-end CNC machine tools, additive manufacturing and other frontier equipment.
notes: Also high-end CNC systems, servo motors, bearings, gratings.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 促进机器人标准化、模块化发展，扩大市场应用
quote_en: Promote standardised, modular robots and widen market applications.
notes: Industrial, special-purpose and service robots; reducers, servo motors, controllers named as bottlenecks.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 加快大型飞机研制，适时启动宽体客机研制
quote_en: Speed up large-aircraft development and start wide-body airliner development in due course.
notes: Also aero-engines, UAVs, general aircraft, airborne systems.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 发展新一代运载火箭、重型运载器，提升进入空间能力
quote_en: Develop new-generation launch vehicles and heavy lifters and raise access-to-space capability.
notes: Also civil space infrastructure, satellites, manned space, lunar exploration.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
concept_zh: 海洋工程装备及高技术船舶
concept_en: offshore engineering equipment and high-tech ships
quote_zh: 大力发展深海探测、资源开发利用、海上作业保障装备及其关键系统和专用设备
quote_en: Vigorously develop deep-sea exploration, resource development and offshore support equipment and key systems.
notes: Also luxury cruise ships and LNG carriers.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 研发新一代绿色智能、高速重载轨道交通装备系统
quote_en: Develop a new generation of green, intelligent, high-speed and heavy-haul rail equipment systems.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 继续支持电动汽车、燃料电池汽车发展
quote_en: Continue to support electric and fuel-cell vehicles.
notes: Also smart/connected vehicle technologies; 推动自主品牌…同国际先进水平接轨.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 提升动力电池、驱动电机、高效内燃机、先进变速器、轻量化材料、智能控制等核心技术
quote_en: Raise core technologies in traction batteries, drive motors, engines, transmissions, lightweight materials and controls.
notes: One of a six-item list (intensity 1).

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 推进新能源和可再生能源装备、先进储能装置、智能电网用输变电及用户端设备发展
quote_en: Advance new- and renewable-energy equipment, advanced energy storage and smart-grid transmission and user-side equipment.
notes: Also 推动大型高效超净排放煤电机组产业化, hydro/nuclear units and heavy gas turbines. L2 none: concept spans most of 电力设备.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 加快发展大型拖拉机及其复式作业机具、大型高效联合收割机等高端农业装备
quote_en: Speed up large tractors and implements, large combine harvesters and other high-end farm equipment.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 做好超导材料、纳米材料、石墨烯、生物基材料等战略前沿材料提前布局和研制
quote_en: Plan ahead and develop frontier strategic materials such as superconductors, nano-materials, graphene and bio-based materials.
notes: Focus list: special metal functional materials, high-performance structural materials, functional polymers, special inorganic non-metals, advanced composites. Cross-sector (metals and chemicals), so none.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 发展针对重大疾病的化学药、中药、生物技术药物新产品
quote_en: Develop new chemical, traditional-Chinese and biotech drugs for major diseases.
notes: Antibodies, ADCs, peptides, vaccines, innovative TCM named.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 提高医疗器械的创新能力和产业化水平，重点发展影像设备、医用机器人等高性能诊疗设备
quote_en: Raise innovation and industrialisation of medical devices, focusing on imaging equipment, medical robots and other high-performance diagnostic and treatment equipment.
notes: Also high-value consumables (degradable stents) and mobile health.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 推动智能交通工具、智能工程机械、服务机器人、智能家电、智能照明电器、可穿戴设备
quote_en: Promote smart vehicles, smart construction machinery, service robots, smart appliances, smart lighting and wearables.
notes: Six-item list (intensity 1); L2 none because white goods / small appliances / lighting not distinguished.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 推动智能交通工具、智能工程机械、服务机器人、智能家电、智能照明电器、可穿戴设备
quote_en: Promote smart vehicles, smart construction machinery, service robots, smart appliances, smart lighting and wearables.
notes: Same list sentence as 智能家电 (intensity 1).

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 推动智能交通工具、智能工程机械、服务机器人、智能家电、智能照明电器、可穿戴设备
quote_en: Promote smart vehicles, smart construction machinery, service robots, smart appliances, smart lighting and wearables.
notes: Same list sentence as 智能家电 (intensity 1).

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 加强工业互联网基础设施建设规划与布局
quote_en: Strengthen planning and layout of industrial-internet infrastructure.
notes: Also industrial cloud and big-data pilots, IoT application demonstrations. Mapped to IT services (judgement).

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
concept_en: energy-saving and environmental technology and equipment
quote_zh: 加大先进节能环保技术、工艺和装备的研发力度，加快制造业绿色改造升级
quote_en: Step up R&D of advanced energy-saving and environmental technology, processes and equipment and speed up green upgrading of manufacturing.
notes: Named project 绿色制造工程 (1,000 green factories, 100 green parks by 2020). 节能环保 also appears in the producer-services list.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
concept_zh: 再制造与资源再生利用
quote_zh: 大力发展再制造产业，实施高端再制造、智能再制造、在役再制造
quote_en: Vigorously develop the remanufacturing industry: high-end, intelligent and in-service remanufacturing.
notes: Sentence before: 推进资源再生利用产业规范化、规模化发展 (S0 wording). SW mapping is a judgement.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
concept_zh: 军民融合与国防科技工业
quote_zh: 稳步推进国防科技工业改革，推动军民融合深度发展
quote_en: Steadily advance defence S&T industry reform and promote deep civil-military integration.
notes: Also 加快国防科技成果转化和产业化; 大力提高国防装备质量可靠性. L1-wide.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 按照“消化一批、转移一批、整合一批、淘汰一批”的原则，分业分类施策，有效化解产能过剩矛盾
quote_en: On the "digest, relocate, consolidate, eliminate" principle, resolve overcapacity effectively by sector and category.
notes: Generic wording in section 稳步化解产能过剩矛盾 (also 加快淘汰落后产能, 引导企业主动退出过剩行业); no sector named, so none. Steel/petrochem are named only in upgrading lists (促进钢铁、石化、工程机械、轻工、纺织等产业向价值链高端发展).

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
concept_zh: 生产性服务业与服务型制造
quote_zh: 大力发展与制造业紧密相关的生产性服务业
quote_en: Vigorously develop producer services closely linked to manufacturing.
notes: Dedicated section (八). Broad services concept; specific services in separate rows.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 推广大型制造设备、生产线等融资租赁服务
quote_en: Promote financial-leasing services for large manufacturing equipment and production lines.
notes: Also 支持符合条件的制造业企业建立企业财务公司、金融租赁公司; 融资租赁 appears again in the producer-services list.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
concept_zh: 面向制造业的信息技术服务
quote_zh: 大力发展面向制造业的信息技术服务
quote_en: Vigorously develop IT services for manufacturing.

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 加快发展研发设计、技术转移、创业孵化、知识产权、科技咨询等科技服务业
quote_en: Speed up technology services such as R&D design, technology transfer, incubation, IP and consulting.
notes: Also industrial-design firms and a national industrial-design award (创新设计 section). Mapped to 专业服务 (judgement).

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 发展壮大第三方物流、节能环保、检验检测认证、电子商务、服务外包、融资租赁
quote_en: Grow third-party logistics, energy-saving/environmental services, testing and certification, e-commerce, outsourcing and leasing.
notes: Nine-item list (intensity 1).

doc_name: 国务院关于印发《中国制造2025》的通知（国发〔2015〕28号）
quote_zh: 鼓励互联网等企业发展移动电子商务、在线定制、线上到线下等创新模式
quote_en: Encourage internet firms to develop mobile e-commerce, online customisation and O2O models.
notes: Also in the nine-item producer-services list.
